risk_if_not_implemented: Without Privileged Command Execution, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Privilege Elevation (R-AC-3), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_1.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Privileged Command Execution (IAC-10.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Privileged Account Management (PAM)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict and control privileged access rights for users and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Privileged Account Management (PAM) (IAC-10) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Privileged Command Execution (IAC-10.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
